name: broker-marker
description: The broker marker on disk, sidecar code 5 (5.46: whatever is chosen is recorded as broker-originated, in the recording and in the audit). When the core acts on the target on the session's behalf — sending Ctrl-L for a stale-grid ctrl_l answer, say — the recording holds one frame coded 5 whose data is the fixed pure-ASCII line x-broker-line, stamped on the core's input clock: CR LF [TSB: stale screen after lost output - <choice> chosen] CR LF. The choice is spelled wiggle, ctrl_l, continue or fresh_session, underscores and all, one spelling everywhere; the separator is a plain ASCII hyphen-minus, never an em dash. A classic ttyrec player prints the line, so the recording tells the truth on its own; a TSB reader knows the marker by its code and parses the choice. Refused: an empty code-5 frame, data that is not the line, a choice with another spelling. Who chose is on the session.stale_choice audit event only.
